name: Borborygmos
description: A Gruul leader who wanted the Gruul to act independently of the other guilds.

description_citations.text: "Skarrg". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At Bolas's urging Domri Rade defeats Borborygmos by setting waves of beasts on him; Borborygmos loses the Gruul's respect.
timeline.quote: the planeswalker Domri Rade challenged and defeated the aging Borborygmos by setting waves of beasts on the cyclops

citation.text: "Gruul Clans", section "Background". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Teysa mocks the Gruul for following Borborygmos.
timeline.quote: the only orders he gives are 'Crush them!' and 'We eat!'

citation.text: Borborygmos (Guildpact, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Borborygmos orders his horde to crush.
timeline.quote: Crush them!

citation.text: Wreak Havoc (Guildpact, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Borborygmos's elemental launched an assault on the Izzet in the Rubblebelt but the wards held.
timeline.quote: Borborygmos's elemental launched an assault, but the Izzet wards held and experiments continue.

citation.text: Scorchwalker (Gatecrash, 2013), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Domri commands ragebeasts to drive the Orzhov out of the Rubblebelt; Borborygmos makes him an honorary Burning Tree member.
timeline.quote: The cyclops declared Domri an honorary member of the Burning Tree clan.

citation.text: "Domri Rade", section "Joining the Gruul". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: With Bolas's help Domri defeats Borborygmos and becomes Gruul guildmaster.
timeline.quote: becoming the guildmaster by defeating the cyclops Borborygmos

citation.text: "Domri Rade", section "Ravnica Allegiance". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rat convinces Borborygmos to support the cause.
timeline.quote: Rat convinced the cyclops (who had a soft spot for her) to support their cause.

citation.text: "Araithia Shokta", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the War of the Spark and Domri's death, Borborygmos becomes acting guildmaster again.
timeline.quote: Borborygmos became acting guildmaster again.

citation.text: "Gruul Clans", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gan Shokta refuses to follow Domri and goes back to Borborygmos, and Domri leads others to the plaza.
timeline.quote: I'm going back to Borborygmos.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica – The Path to Opulent" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Rat leads Kaya and Teyo through the sewers, picking a lock, to Skarrg, where Gan Shokta and Borborygmos are fighting.
timeline.quote: Gan Shokta was fighting with the cyclops Borborygmos

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Gan Shokta and Ari show Gan that Rat is present and Rat urges them and Borborygmos to unite the Clans.
timeline.quote: You must unite the Clans and help the other guilds.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Rat whispers to Borborygmos and kisses his cheek, winning the Gruul over.
timeline.quote: I cupped my hands and whispered again. Then I kissed his cheek.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Ari and Gan Shokta see Rat; Rat tells Boruvo, Ari, Gan and the Selesnya to get along.
timeline.quote: Both squinted at the space next to Teyo until they could see me.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: The guild representatives arrive; Lazav reveals he was disguised as Varryvort.
timeline.quote: Guildmaster Lazav of House Dimir reveal that he had been there all along

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Nissa leads the ritual; leylines light under the ten guild representatives and they fall into a trance with golden light pouring from their eyes.
timeline.quote: Suddenly, golden light poured out of twenty-one sightless eyes.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Operation Desperation" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Guild forces and planeswalkers charge the Citadel as the Dreadhorde engages them.
timeline.quote: Those Planeswalkers not fallen—or not yet fallen—were side by side with guild warriors, engaging the silent Dreadhorde.

citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Ashes" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: Chandra and Jaya burn the remaining Dreadhorde to ashes with dignity at Samut's request.
timeline.quote: meticulously burned every last one—every last fragment—down to ashes

citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Ashes" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Jun 2019.

timeline.summary: The Gruul fight in Ravnica's defense in the Phyrexian invasion; Borborygmos gains respect and Nikya blocks the Golgari from the surface.
timeline.quote: Borborygmos' ferocious fighting earned him even more respect and loyalty.

citation.text: "Gruul Clans", section "The Phyrexian invasion and its aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rat tells Ari that Gan Shokta and Borborygmos are fighting; Ari helps mediate and attends the ritual to resurrect Niv-Mizzet.
timeline.quote: She was present during the ritual to resurrect Niv-Mizzet

citation.text: "Ari Shokta", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: As a favor to Niv-Mizzet, Borborygmos attends the guild summit for the Gruul, costing him respect among his people.
timeline.quote: This cost him much respect and honor amongst his people, for whom cooperation was anathema.

citation.text: "Borborygmos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At Bolas's urging, Domri defeats the aging Borborygmos with waves of beasts; he is not killed but loses respect and lives as a Trog in the Rubblebelt.
timeline.quote: Afterward, he lived as a Trog (hermit) in the Rubblebelt.

citation.text: "Borborygmos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Borborygmos acts as guildmaster again after Domri's death and is convinced by Kaya's group to aid the guilds against the Dreadhorde.
timeline.quote: He was convinced by Kaya 's group to aid the guilds in the fight against the Dreadhorde .

citation.text: "Borborygmos", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Borborygmos represents the Gruul at the resurrection of Niv-Mizzet as the Living Guildpact.
timeline.quote: He served as the representative for the Gruul at the resurrection of Niv-Mizzet

citation.text: "Borborygmos", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion Borborygmos rescues Fblthp from Phyrexianized Golgari, and they fight together.
timeline.quote: Luckily, he was rescued by Borborygmos, who happened to be smashing Phyrexians nearby.

citation.text: "Borborygmos", section "Phyrexian Invasion and its aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion Fblthp runs away, lands on the frontlines, and is rescued by Borborygmos.
timeline.quote: he was rescued by Borborygmos

citation.text: "Fblthp", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Fblthp stays to assist Borborygmos in defending Ravnica.
timeline.quote: Fblthp decided to stay and assist

citation.text: "Fblthp", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gan denounces Domri after Domri declares an alliance with Nicol Bolas and leaves the group to return to Borborygmos.
timeline.quote: He then left Domri and the group, maintaining his integrity and commitment to his principles.

citation.text: "Gan Shokta", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gan confronts Borborygmos over the guild's direction until Rat and Ari bring urgent news; Gan accepts the outsiders on seeing his daughter.
timeline.quote: Gan Shokta engaged in a conflict with him over the direction of the guild.

citation.text: "Gan Shokta", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Domri Rade replaces Borborygmos; Ruric Thar resents him and launches raids into the Tenth District.
timeline.quote: They channeled his anger into a series of brutal raids

citation.text: "Ruric Thar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Borborygmos and Gan Shokta come to a showdown at Skarrg over whether the Gruul should act alone or cooperate with other guilds, and break into a fight.
timeline.quote: The two broke into a fight

citation.text: "Skarrg", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Araithia Shokta intervenes and convinces Borborygmos to let go of his grudges, allowing the Gruul to band together with the plane's defenders.
timeline.quote: Gan's daughter Araithia Shokta intervened and convinced Borborygmos to let go of his grudges against the other guilds

citation.text: "Skarrg", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
